name: SIH Copilot
description: A review workspace for the SIH 2026 problem-statement portal. Adds status tagging, persistent notes, advanced filters, historical-repeat detection (semantic similarity against 2024–2025 PS datasets), and Team Fit scoring that ranks every PS against your team’s skill matrix — all locally in your browser.
author: mudassirdjsce
